item.text:
`orders.js` provides order totals, percentage discounts, average item pricing, and text order formatting.

Bugs:

- [test/orders.js:5](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw\test\orders.js:5) loops with `i <= items.length`, so it accesses `items[items.length]` (undefined) and throws on `.price`; use `<`.
- [test/orders.js:20](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw\test\orders.js:20) returns `NaN` for an empty item list (`0 / 0`).
- [test/orders.js:19](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw\test\orders.js:19) `averageItemPrice` divides the quantity-weighted total by number of lines; if it means average unit price, it should divide by total quantity.
